question: Should OpenClaw accept read-scoped runtime-config drift path names and per-cache-hit disk snapshot reads as the health diagnostic tradeoff for PR #89526?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-proven, but auth-adjacent visibility and health RPC freshness cost are product/operations choices that tests cannot fully settle.

options.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and the terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path moving from ok to drift.

options.title: Request Extra Privacy Or Latency Proof
options.body: Ask for a read-vs-admin transcript or health latency sample before merge if maintainers are not comfortable with drift path visibility or per-request disk reads.

options.title: Pause For Companion Policy PR
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want diagnostics and the hot-mode restart policy in PR #89517 reviewed and landed together.

recommendation.title: Accept Diagnostic Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head CI because the diff is additive, redaction is tested, and the terminal proof shows the normal read-scoped health path moving from ok to drift.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-main history signal for the health command, health payload, and gateway cache surfaces affected by the decision.
